name: listint
description: Search live UAE property listings on Listint — units, whole properties and developer projects.

interface.longDescription:
Listint is a UAE real-estate marketplace. The app lets people search live property listings by area, price, size, bedrooms, bathrooms, property type, amenities, views, furnishing, ownership and completion status, and open any result on listint.com.

Three kinds of inventory are searchable: units (individual apartments, villas, townhouses and commercial space, offered both for sale and to rent), properties (whole assets such as residential and mixed-use buildings, villa compounds and land, offered for sale) and projects (developer developments, both off-plan and ready). Results render as an inline carousel of listing cards showing the photo, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, size, location, agency and construction progress, with a map view that plots every result and flies to a listing as the user browses. In fullscreen the app shows the result list, the map and the selected listing side by side.

The app is read-only: it searches published listings and links out to listint.com. It does not create, modify or delete anything, does not take payments, and requires no sign-in. Listing data is served from Listint's own index; map tiles come from Mapbox and listing imagery from Listint's CDN.

Coverage is concentrated in the United Arab Emirates — principally Abu Dhabi and Dubai, with some listings in Ras Al Khaimah — alongside a smaller selection of buildings and projects in Egypt, the United Kingdom, Oman, Morocco, Latvia and Ethiopia. Inventory changes continuously, so the app reports when it has nothing in a requested location rather than offering listings elsewhere as matches. All prices are quoted in AED.
defaultPrompt: Show me 2 bedroom apartments for sale in Abu Dhabi
Find villas for rent in Dubai
What off-plan projects are launching on Saadiyat Island?

positive.description: Search units to rent by property type and city, exercising the rent category and the type filter.
positive.prompt: Show me villas for rent in Dubai
positive.expected_behavior: A carousel of villas available to rent in Dubai, each card showing the annual rent in AED, bedrooms, bathrooms, size and the listing agency, with a link through to the full result set on listint.com.

positive.description: Search units for sale by bedroom count, property type and emirate, exercising the bedroom filter.
positive.prompt: Find 2 bedroom apartments for sale in Abu Dhabi
positive.expected_behavior: Two-bedroom apartments for sale in Abu Dhabi, every result having exactly two bedrooms, each showing price in AED, size and community.

positive.description: Superlative phrasing should sort by price ascending rather than returning an arbitrary result, and a studio should return homes rather than commercial space.
positive.prompt: What's the cheapest studio for sale in Abu Dhabi?
positive.expected_behavior: Residential studio apartments for sale in Abu Dhabi ordered from the lowest price upward, with the cheapest first. Shops, offices and warehouses are excluded even though they also have no bedrooms.

positive.description: Search developer projects rather than individual units, exercising the project collection together with the developer and completion-status filters.
positive.prompt: Show me off-plan projects by Aldar Properties in Abu Dhabi
positive.expected_behavior: Off-plan developments attributed to Aldar Properties in Abu Dhabi, each card showing the project name, developer, location, starting price and construction progress.

positive.description: Follow-up on a named development, exercising the detail lookup by id after a search resolves the name.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the Saadiyat Grove project
positive.expected_behavior: The full record for Saadiyat Grove: an off-plan Aldar Properties development on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi, with its starting price, unit types, completion status and amenities, and a link to its page on listint.com.

negative.description: Requests unrelated to property should not trigger the app.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: A location outside the app's coverage must be reported plainly, never answered with another country's inventory.
negative.prompt: Find me a two bedroom apartment to rent in Tokyo

negative.description: Financial advice is outside the app's scope; it has no mortgage, rates or affordability capability.
negative.prompt: What mortgage rate should I lock in for a UAE property purchase?

review.commerce_description: Listint only searches published listings and links out to listint.com. It sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes:
Searches that used to come back empty now widen one step at a time and say
exactly what they had to give up, so an over-specific request returns close
matches instead of nothing. Asking for a studio returns homes rather than
shops and warehouses. Searching a city Listint does not cover now says so
plainly instead of showing listings from somewhere else. Rental listings and
coverage beyond Abu Dhabi — Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah and a selection of
international projects — are now described accurately in the app and in both
skills.
